headline: Strait of Hormuz: Oil tanker reports explosions
summary: An oil tanker reported explosions in the Strait of Hormuz, putting the strategic waterway in focus. The energy market is weighing the risk to flows and prices.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global seaborne oil and LNG, so disruptions there quickly affect crude prices and shipping costs.
why_moved: Reports of explosions on an oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz raise the risk to crude flows through the strait, which the energy market is weighing.
